accom_shared_hostel_dorm.sourceTitle: Hanoi Average Hostel Prices | Budget Your Trip
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.evidenceText: The average price for a dorm bed in a hostel in Hanoi (based on data from 79 hostels with dorms) is an affordable $8.
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.referencePeriod: Crawled 3 weeks ago; current city average; source also notes taxes and fees are excluded from weekly figures
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.searchQuery: Hanoi Vietnam hostel dorm bed average price per night one adult

accom_hostel_private_room.searchQuery: Hanoi Vietnam hostel private room average price per night two adults
accom_hostel_private_room.reason: Search results exposed hostel private-room averages or individual prices, but none explicitly established a central non-from price for one private room occupied by two adults; the available Hostelworld prices were from prices and other snippets lacked the required occupancy identity.

accom_1_star.searchQuery: Hanoi Vietnam 1-star hotel city average price per room per night two adults
accom_1_star.reason: Search results supplied 1-star averages or from prices without an explicit two-adult, one-room central price; weekend/weekday rates and generic hotel averages were not compatible with the contract.

accom_2_star.searchQuery: Hanoi Vietnam 2-star hotel city average price per room per night two adults
accom_2_star.reason: Search results exposed 2-star city or weekday/weekend averages, but no central non-from price explicitly identified one room for two adults; generic hotel rates and lowest/from quotes were rejected.

accom_3_star.searchQuery: Hanoi Vietnam 3-star hotel city average price per room per night two adults
accom_3_star.reason: Booking snippets included 2-adult context but reported a this-weekend price rather than a central non-event average; other results were generic or lowest/from quotes, so the definition-compatible value is not found.

accom_4_star.searchQuery: Hanoi Vietnam 4-star hotel city average price per room per night two adults
accom_4_star.reason: Search results supplied Booking weekend averages or KAYAK/HotelsCombined averages without explicit two-adult, one-room occupancy; Expedia described a 2-adult price trend but exposed no class-specific central numeric value.
